interactions.author: ueli
interactions.summary: Reworked the Heating + Cooling finger exercise: cover page with the supplied screenshot, exact geometry (plan, elevations, coordinate tables read from entwurf.gh), exact 60-row energiebilanz.csv contract, Grasshopper recommended, and no prescribed energy values.
